title: onboard-solis-13b-v1.0-perf-metadata-changelog-automation
author: Maya Thompson
description:
Motivation: Add initial onboarding for solis-13b v1.0 with curated performance profiles, canonical metadata, and automated changelog/release-notes generation. This PR combines model metadata, per-hardware performance profiles (GPU/CPU), and a workflow + helper script that generates release notes based on model metadata and perf results. The automation allows maintainers to produce consistent release notes for new model versions and reduces manual errors when publishing model changelogs.

What this PR does: 
- Adds model metadata and canonical manifest for solis-13b v1.0 (architecture, tokenizer, license, recommended quantization profiles).
- Adds perf profiles: p95 latency and tokens/sec for common instance types (A100-40GB, T4, CPU-avx2) and batch/sequence configurations.
- Introduces scripts/automation/auto_changelog.py and a GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/model-onboard.yml) that: run perf smoke tests, validate metadata, and assemble release notes into models/solis-13b/v1.0/CHANGELOG.md.
- Adds docs/models/solis-13b.md with quickstart and recommended runtimes.
- Adds tests: tests/perf/solis-13b-smoke.test and unit tests for the changelog generator.

Checklist: 
- [x] model manifest (models/solis-13b/v1.0/metadata.yaml)
- [x] perf profiles (perf-profiles/solis-13b-v1.0.json)
- [x] changelog automation script and workflow
- [x] docs and quickstart
- [x] unit + perf smoke tests

Notes on compatibility and rollout: The perf profiles include fallback recommendations for Dedicated/Private deployments. The changelog generator is opt-in via a metadata flag (release_notes: auto) so existing models are unaffected. We validated that the generated CHANGELOG.md follows the standard template used by the model registry.

Related: ENG-4821 (model onboarding spec), SUP-3112 (customer request for solis in production).

review_comments: Diego Alvarez: Overall looks good. Can you include CPU perf with AVX-512 fallback? For our private-onprem builds AVX-512 isn't guaranteed — prefer AVX2 numbers and call out AVX-512 as optional.
Maya Thompson: Updated perf profiles to include AVX2 primary numbers and AVX-512 as optional. Added a note in the docs (docs/models/solis-13b.md) about hardware requirements.

Priya Nair: The changelog generator needs to escape markdown in model notes to avoid malformed tables when special characters appear. Also add a unit test covering a description with pipes and newlines.
Maya Thompson: Added escaping and an extra unit test (tests/unit/test_auto_changelog.py). CI initially failed on this — reran after fix and tests passed.

Lena Park: Approved. Verified generated CHANGELOG.md in branch artifacts matches template and includes perf table and recommended runtimes. Small nit: prefer 'Recommended runtime' header to be level-3. Fixed in final commit.
Maya Thompson: Addressed Lena's header level change and squashed. Thanks!
ci_checks: model-validator: fail (initial - missing AVX2 fallback) -> pass (after fix)
release_notes:
- Onboarded solis-13b v1.0: model manifest and canonical metadata.
- Added curated performance profiles (A100-40GB, T4, CPU AVX2) with p95 latency and throughput guidance.
- Introduced changelog automation: a script + GitHub Actions workflow that validates metadata, runs smoke perf tests, and generates models/<model>/v<version>/CHANGELOG.md. Opt-in via metadata flag 'release_notes: auto'.
- Documentation and quickstart for solis-13b added to docs/models/solis-13b.md.

Notes: This onboarding includes fallback guidance for Dedicated and Private deployments and avoids breaking changes to the registry. Model owners can opt out of automation by setting 'release_notes: manual' in the manifest.
notes: This PR was intentionally kept to a single feature branch to simplify backout if the automation causes unexpected workflow runs. The automation scripts are idempotent and include dry-run mode. Post-merge: will monitor the onboarding workflow for two weeks and collect metrics for false positive/negative validations.
